arguments.value: This agreement amends and restates an earlier cooperation agreement between Nanjing Tuniu Technology and Beijing Tuniu Technology. Party A agrees to use Party B as its exclusive provider of business consulting, technical consulting, and related services for the online sale and promotion of tour products, and not to work with third parties or engage in competing activities without Party B’s consent. Party B provides or arranges the needed services, and Party A and its subsidiaries must pay service fees equal to the profits earned from the cooperative business, on a quarterly basis, with late-payment interest if overdue. The agreement lasts until Party B’s operating term ends, can generally only be terminated by Party B, and includes force majeure, confidentiality, intellectual property ownership by Party B, dispute resolution by arbitration in Beijing, and Chinese law as the governing law.
